summary: Six readers are observed seated around a large table in a library setting, each with an open book. Most remain focused on reading, while two individuals look up or stand up during the observation window. Page turns are observed for Reader A and Reader B.

people.label: Reader A
people.description: Seated at the near-left end of the table wearing a blue hoodie.

segments.reason: Maintains sustained gaze toward the open book on the table and turns pages.

page_turns.reason: Lifts a page with his right hand, turns it across the spine, and lays it flat on the left side.
Lifts a page from the right side and flips it over to the left side.

people.label: Reader B
people.description: Seated along the far-left side of the table wearing a burgundy cardigan over a white top.

segments.reason: Keeps head bowed toward the open book with continuous line-following gaze.

page_turns.reason: Lifts a page from the right sheet and turns it over to the left side.

people.label: Reader C
people.description: Seated at the far-middle side of the table wearing a cream sweater and glasses.

segments.reason: Remains focused on the open book in front of her throughout the entire duration.

people.label: Reader D
people.description: Seated at the far-right side of the top row wearing a pale sweater with long dark hair.

segments.reason: Gaze is directed downwards toward the open book on the desk.
Sits up straight and looks up away from the book toward the room.

people.label: Reader E
people.description: Seated along the right side of the table wearing a bright orange sweater.

segments.reason: Head orientation and gaze are directed at the open book on the table.
Looks up, stands up from her chair, and looks away from the book.

people.label: Reader F
people.description: Seated closest to the bottom-center of the frame wearing a gray sweater with long dark hair.

segments.reason: Sustained downward head angle toward the open book directly in front of her.
